verdict.rationale: Featurebase explicitly markets an AI feature to 'declutter & find the most impactful opportunities' from feedback, directly matching the story's core claim (featurebase-docs-7). However, this is a single marketing-line mention with no further documentation of how the AI clusters/prioritizes feedback, no product screenshots, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of its effectiveness. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the AI declutter/prioritization workflow, concrete examples or screenshots, and independent verification that it works as claimed.
